attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `dmsA` to `infA`, are carried by 90 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and only 3 to 4% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 54 to 99% of these genes, fewest at `cydC`, named 54%, and hesitates most at `aat`, 0.28 bits.

**Then the graph opens into fork and variable columns.** Columns 11 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 9 to 35% of calls, and the model names 34 to 97% of genes, fewest at column 34, named 34%. Its hesitation peaks at column 11, `clpA`, 1.06 bits. Columns 11 to 47 are variable, carried by 76 to 88% of chromosomes, and hold the `art` and `pot` families, [[arginine and polyamine transport]].

**Two parallel branches run through the forks.** Columns 48 to 56 carry a branch of 9 families, in 15 to 25% of chromosomes, all shell, from a zinc finger protein to a recombinase, [[phage tail assembly]]. Columns 62 to 78 carry a branch of 17 families, in 14 to 20% of chromosomes, all shell, from a baseplate protein to a portal protein, [[phage capsid and lysis]]. The most carried families there include the `gsi` genes, [[glutathione transport]], and `moeA` to `moeB`, [[molybdopterin biosynthesis]].

**The window ends in fork columns.** Column 79, `opgE`, is carried by 29% of chromosomes, with `ompX` also at 14%. The model hesitates most at `yliI`, 1.01 bits, and at `opgE`, 0.88 bits, both in a region of plasticity in 28% of calls. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.77 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 69% against 95%.

label: dmsA
facts:
WINDOW: the dmsA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor dmsA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,805 to 2,884 from dnaA. Read in 528 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying dmsA once); 42,240 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.44 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,565 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 7,580 calls, named 78%, 1.18 bits; cloud 1,095 calls, named 15%, 4.43 bits. Outside an RGP 34,976 calls, named 95%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 7,264 calls, named 69%, 1.77 bits. Columns: 11 spine, 30 fork, 39 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.77 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (69% against 95%); 7,264 of the 42,240 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 11 (clpA) 1.06 bits, RGP 12%; column 57 (yliI) 1.01 bits, RGP 28%; column 79 (opgE) 0.88 bits, RGP 28%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 11-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 9-35%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 3-4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 90-100%, all P, RGP 3-4%. Genes: dmsA, serS, rarA, lolA, ftsK, lrp, trxB, cydD, cydC "heme ABC transporter ATP-binding pr…", aat, infA. named 54-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 8 (cydC), named 54%; most hesitant at column 9 (aat), 0.28 bits.
2. columns 11-79 (69 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 9-35%. named 34-97% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 34, named 34%; most hesitant at column 11, 1.06 bits.
   a second branch of 9 families through columns 48-56, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-25%, all S; the branch's families: "ogr/Delta-like zinc finger family prote…", "contractile injection system protein, V…", "phage tail protein", "phage tail tape measure protein", "GpE family phage tail protein", "phage tail assembly protein", "phage major tail tube protein", "phage tail sheath subtilisin-like domai…", "recombinase family protein"
